notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-28 after Next.js/Zod/shadcn and targeted transitive security updates. Prisma CLI/Client/pg adapter remain at 7.10.0 under the existing user deferral. exceptions.reachability: ESLint and shadcn execute during development/build. shadcn remains in dependencies as before, but the application imports only its static Tailwind CSS, not its JavaScript CLI in request handlers. Glob patterns come from repository-controlled files/configuration; HTTP input is never passed to braces. No patched braces release is available. Do not run these tools with untrusted patterns or registries; review upstream before this exception expires.

Used by Prisma CLI configuration loaded from repository-controlled files. Go-Trail request handlers do not import prisma/config or merge attacker-controlled recursive object graphs. A fix is available through Prisma 7.10.1, but the user explicitly deferred this coordinated dependency upgrade until open PRs are merged and the team resyncs from develop. Keep this exception time-bounded and do not load untrusted Prisma config.

MySQL driver bundled by Prisma CLI. Go-Trail uses PostgreSQL via the pg adapter and does not open MySQL connections or use mysql_clear_password. A patch is available through Prisma 7.10.1; the user deferred the upgrade until current PRs are merged and the team resyncs from develop. This exception must be reviewed before enabling any MySQL path and before expiry.

Affected path requires a compressed MySQL connection to a malicious or compromised MySQL server. Go-Trail uses PostgreSQL via pg and does not enable the MySQL compressed protocol. A patch is available through Prisma 7.10.1; the user deferred the coordinated upgrade until open PRs are merged and the team resyncs from develop. Review before any MySQL use or exception expiry.

Reviewed and explicitly approved by the user on 2026-10-28. Upstream latest deepmerge 4.3.1 has no patched release. Go-Trail imports only shadcn/tailwind.css; no application or server code imports the shadcn JavaScript CLI or deepmerge. The CSS bytes are unchanged after the shadcn security update. CLI merge inputs are repository-controlled configuration; do not run shadcn against untrusted registries/configuration. Re-review before production, enabling any JavaScript import, or the existing deadline. This is a temporary development-tool exception, not a claim that deepmerge is fixed.

Reviewed and authorized by the project lead on 2026-11-02. All modern minimatch 10 copies are patched to 11.0.4. Only legacy 3.1.5 remains in ESLint and its plugins, whose callable CommonJS API is incompatible with minimatch 11 (verified TypeError on a legacy call). Upstream legacy-v3 tag remains 3.1.5. The reported firstPhasePreProcess/optimizationLevel path is absent from the installed v3 source; npm still reports this version under the advisory's broad affected range, so this is a temporary risk acceptance, not a claim the advisory is fixed. Glob input comes from repository-controlled lint configuration; application request handlers do not import minimatch or expose arbitrary glob matching. The audit gate checks every reported affected node against the authoritative lockfile and accepts only exact 3.1.5; any affected 10.x, unknown version or missing evidence still blocks CI. Re-review before release, untrusted glob/config input, changing lint dependencies, or expiry.
